title: "Consulting & collaboration"

Alongside my research roles, I take on a limited amount of consulting work. Areas where I can help:

- **Evidence synthesis** — systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and network meta-analyses, from protocol and PROSPERO registration to manuscript.
- **Health economic evaluation** — cost-effectiveness and budget impact analysis, survival modelling, decision curve analysis.
- **Methodological review** — critical appraisal of study protocols, grant applications, and manuscripts.

I am also open to academic collaboration on cardiovascular imaging and health economics and outcomes research topics.

If this fits your project, [email me](mailto:bisacciagiandomenico@gmail.com) with a short description of what you have in mind, or use the [contact form](contact.qmd).
